;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] and Syrian state media say that a [[American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War|U.S.-led coalition]] aerial attack killed 11 civilians in [[Deir ez-Zor Governorate]]. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/internacional/20190103/453923983423/mueren-once-civiles-en-el-noreste-de-siria-por-un-bombardeo-de-la-coalicion.html (EFE via ''La Vanguardia'')] [https://sana.sy/en/?p=154758 (SANA)]

;Business and economy
*[[Lists of corporate acquisitions and mergers|Corporate acquisitions and mergers]]
**[[Pharmaceutical industry|Pharmaceutical company]] [[Bristol-Myers Squibb]] proposes the takeover of [[List of antineoplastic agents|cancer drug]] company [[Celgene]] for [[United States dollar|US$]]95 billion, including debt, the biggest [[Biopharmaceutical|biopharma]] deal ever. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-celgene-m-a-bristol-myers/bristol-myers-to-buy-celgene-for-74-billion-in-largest-biopharma-deal-idUSKCN1OX0VM (Reuters)]
*The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] drops 660 points following a warning from [[Apple Inc.|Apple]] on weak demand and [[trade relations between the US and China|trade relations between the United States and China]]. [https://www.thestreet.com/amp/markets/dow-sinks-after-revenue-warning-from-apple-14823393?fbclid=IwAR3vgZzHuobuusvLAoQ6B5bMgs3i8ceipEUbC3Pn7f-IxtDQFgMtuU44uMg (TheStreet)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Magnitogorsk building collapse]]
**The death toll of an explosion caused by a gas leak that devastated a block of flats in [[Magnitogorsk]], [[Russia]], rises to 39. Rescuers end their search efforts at the collapse site as there are no more missing people. [https://themoscowtimes.com/news/rescuers-end-search-at-magnitogorsk-building-collapse-site-final-death-toll-39-64033 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**The [[List of mayors of Naples|mayor of Naples]] offers to berth a [[Non-governmental organization|NGO]]-operated ship with 32 migrants who were rescued on 22 December in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of [[Libya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-ngo-italy/naples-mayor-offers-to-welcome-in-stranded-ngo-migrant-boat-idUSKCN1OX14L (Reuters)]
*The [[Netherlands Coastguard|Dutch Coast Guard]] says 270 containers fell off ''[[MSC Zoe]]'' in heavy seas near the [[Germany|German]] island of [[Borkum]] and floated towards the [[Netherlands]]. Treasure hunters revel on the [[West Frisian Islands|West Frisian islands]] of [[Terschelling]] and [[Vlieland]]. Three containers containing hazardous materials are still missing and ships are warned for floating containers. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/flat-screen-tvs-car-parts-wash-ashore-as-cargo-ship-containers-break-in-heavy-seas-1972284 (Reuters via NDTV)] [https://worldmaritimenews.com/archives/267734/photos-over-200-containers-fall-from-msc-zoe-amid-heavy-weather/ (''World Maritime News'')]
*Seven people are killed after a crash and diesel fuel spill sparked a massive fire on [[Interstate 75 in Florida|Interstate 75]] in [[Gainesville, Florida]], United States. [https://www.aol.com/article/news/2019/01/03/7-killed-after-fiery-crash-fuel-spill-on-florida-interstate/23633035/ (AOL News)]
*[[14th Street Tunnel shutdown]]
**[[New York (state)|New York]] Governor [[Andrew Cuomo]] announces that a complete shutdown of the [[14th Street Tunnel]] in [[New York City]], proposed to allow for subway repairs caused by damage from [[Hurricane Sandy]], has been halted. Cuomo says that engineers will use a new technology from [[Europe]] to make critical repairs to the tunnel without having to close it entirely. The complete shutdown would have closed the tunnel, which is used by nearly 225,000 people each weekday, for an expected 15 months. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/03/nyregion/l-train-shutdown.html?fbclid=IwAR0sFInoa9FRuxSVXuch7Hqzr5p601_GoKYCN9p3Jo9kWd_1BQorjfAIf9s (''The New York Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Somalia]] expels [[Nicholas Haysom]], the most senior [[United Nations]] diplomat in the country, after accusing him of "acting like the country's ruler". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-46734994 (BBC News)]
*[[President of Afghanistan|Afghan President]] [[Ashraf Ghani]] demands clarification after [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] said yesterday that the [[Soviet Union]] was "right to be there", referring to the 1979–1989 [[Soviet–Afghan War]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/we-gave-more-than-enough-sacrifices-afghans-blast-trumps-praise-of-the-soviet-invasion/2019/01/03/365b01f6-0f4a-11e9-92b8-6dd99e2d80e1_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Mexico-United States barrier]]
**The [[Department of Homeland Security]] requests more American troops be deployed to the [[Mexico-United States border]] in order to add 160 miles of [[concertina wire]] alongside existing border fencing. [https://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Trump-administration-requests-more-US-troops-at-Mexican-border-576326?fbclid=IwAR3vBQaZIb-P04or2meHItoUXx_aRXWi0McJk6ZBF6u-S8znwS0ZtQ9f5hw (''Jerusalem Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[China]] [[capital punishment in China|executes]] [[serial killer]] [[Gao Chengyong]], who [[murder]]ed eleven girls and women between 1988 and 2002. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-46743882 (BBC News)]
*The [[Prosecutor General of Russia]] [[Yury Chaika]] says that [[France]] today extradited {{ill|Alexei Viktorovich Kuznetsov|ru|Кузнецов, Алексей Викторович}}, a former Finance Minister of the [[Moscow Oblast|Moscow Region]] who is accused of fraud and embezzlement amounting to 14 billion [[Russian ruble]]s (US$200 million). [http://tass.com/emergencies/1038912 (TASS)]
*A man shoots three children to death and wounds a woman in [[Texas City, Texas]], United States. The suspect has not been apprehended. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2019/01/03/three-children-killed-texas-city-texas-police-search-suspect/2478896002/ (''USA Today'')]

;Politics and elections
*Iran's health minister [[Hassan Ghazizadeh Hashemi]] resigns in protest against a medical budget. His resignation was accepted by President [[Hassan Rouhani]]. [https://www.presstv.com/Detail/2019/01/03/584754/Iran-Health-Minister-Rouhani-Resignation (PressTV)]

*[[United States federal government shutdown of 2018–2019]]
**The newly sworn [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] passes a major spending bill to fund most shuttered departments and agencies through September 30 and a stop-gap measure to restart the [[United States Department of Homeland Security|Department of Homeland Security]]. The proposals will now move on to the [[United States Senate|Senate]] which has indicated they will not take up any spending bills that aren't supported by President Trump. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/03/us/politics/new-congress.html ''(The New York Times)'']

;Science and technology
*[[Chinese Lunar Exploration Program]]
**[[China National Space Administration]]'s robotic lander [[Chang'e 4]] successfully lands at the [[Von Kármán (lunar crater)|Von Kármán]] lunar crater on the [[far side of the Moon]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-46724727 (BBC News)]

;Sports
*[[Oman–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**Saoud al-Mohannadi, vice president of the [[Asian Football Confederation]], is banned from traveling to the [[United Arab Emirates]] from [[Oman]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/01/03/sports/qatar-soccer-asian-cup.html (''The New York Times'')]
* In women's [[college basketball]], [[2018–19 Baylor Lady Bears basketball team|Baylor]] defeats top-ranked [[2018–19 Connecticut Huskies women's basketball team|Connecticut]] 68–57, handing the [[Connecticut Huskies women's basketball|Huskies]] their first regular-season loss since [[2014–15 Connecticut Huskies women's basketball team|November 2014]] and ending their [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]]-record regular-season winning streak at 126 games. [http://www.espn.com/womens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401090567 (AP via ESPN)]
